features.description: Entry modules implicitly import std/option and std/result. Reuse the EXISTING constructor-import machinery (resolveConstructorImport / RegisterConstructor / findConstructorMatches) rather than building a new prelude constructor registry. Add the two module paths to the entry module's dependency+import set (compile-time depIfaces AND runtime inst.Imports) so Option/Result type cons, Some/None/Ok/Err data cons, and their $adt factories are all in scope with ZERO changes to the type checker, elaborator, or runtime resolver core. User-written `import std/option (...)` must dedupe (not double-load), and library (non-entry) modules must NOT get the injection.
acceptance_criteria: `pure func f(x:int) -> Option[int] = if x>0 then Some(x) else None` type-checks with NO import (currently fails `undefined variable: Some at :N` from typechecker_literals.go:62)
Same for Result/Ok/Err: `func g(x:int) -> Result[int,string] = if x>0 then Ok(x) else Err("neg")` type-checks with no import

Injection is ENTRY-ONLY: gated on IsEntryModuleFromAST(unit.Surface) exactly like InjectPrelude at pipeline_module_compile.go:69 — a library module (module with no exported 0/unit-arity main) using Some WITHOUT import STILL fails (verified today it fails at lib.ail:4:3)
A user who writes `import std/option (Option, Some, None)` in an entry module does NOT get a duplicate-load / ambiguous-constructor error (dedupe against explicit AST imports)
std/option and std/result appear in the entry module's runtime inst.Imports so findConstructorMatches (resolver.go:256-283) resolves the $adt factory at eval time

features.description: Guarantee prelude LOSES to user definitions and user imports, for TYPES and CONSTRUCTORS (not just functions). Match patterns using bare Some/None/Ok/Err must resolve without import. A user-defined local `type Option[a] = Some(a) | None` or `type Result = Pending | Done` (DIFFERENT constructors) must shadow the injected import with NO ambiguity error. Ordering: the implicit import must be registered such that a local type decl or explicit import for the same name takes precedence (place implicit imports FIRST / lowest precedence so local constructors override in elaborator.constructors and ctorTypes; ensure runtime does not see two same-name-same-type matches).
acceptance_criteria: `match opt { Some(x) => x, None => 0 }` with NO import resolves (elaborator registers Some/None as constructors, not variable patterns)
User-defined `type Option[a] = Some(a) | None` locally shadows the prelude: no ambiguous-constructor error at compile OR runtime
User-defined `type Result = Pending | Done` (different constructors, same type name) compiles and runs; injected Result does not clash
Explicit `import std/option (Some, None)` in an entry module coexists with the implicit injection (dedupe — no ambiguity)

AliasParams (PR #381) non-interaction confirmed: Option/Result are ADTs registered via ctorTypes/factory schemes, NOT the alias env (RegisterTypeAliasParams) — a `type Box[a] = a` alias in the same file still expands correctly with the injection active

features.description: End-to-end runtime execution, full fixture test suite, example file, prompt + docs. Prove `ailang run` (not just `ailang check`) works: construct + match + Result all execute to correct output with no import. Add the Conflict-Surface fixture list as tests. Decide cache-key: implicit deps CHANGE the entry module's dependency digest set, so entry-module cache keys shift naturally via ModuleCacheKey's depDigests — NO cacheKeyVersion bump needed unless an Iface gob/JSON struct changes (it does not). Verify make verify-examples and make verify-stdlib stay green.
acceptance_criteria: `ailang run --entry main --caps IO` on a no-import Some/None program prints correct output (matches the WITH-import baseline: `42`)
`ailang run` on a no-import Ok/Err program executes correctly

Fixture tests (from doc Conflict Surface §4) ALL pass: (a) explicit `import std/option (Option,Some,None)` unchanged, (b) local `type Option[a]=Some(a)|None` shadows, (c) local `type Result=Pending|Done` shadows, (d) non-entry library module WITHOUT import still requires import, (e) `match opt { Some(x)=>x, None=>0 }` no-import resolves

`make test` green, `make verify-stdlib` green, `make verify-examples` green (no new failures)
